yorum: I might come off as a bit of a “Karen” here, but this is actually the first time we’ve ever complained about a hotel. We’ve travelled a lot, and honestly, we’ve never experienced such a lack of service. From the start, we felt like we had to constantly chase staff for even the smallest things. We booked a room advertised as 24 m² with a bed between 150–180 cm. What we got was maybe half the size, with a bed barely 130 cm wide, no sofa as pictured, and the hardest mattress I’ve ever slept on — no topper, nothing. The fridge wasn’t cold, the shower was broken and flooded the bathroom (ruining towels, toilet paper, and some clothes), and replacements for basics like toilet paper took several hours and multiple follow-ups. The receptionist initially insisted it was the correct room, then finally admitted we’d been misplaced due to overbookings — yet despite being put in an inferior room, there was zero offer of compensation or a genuine apology. The reception team could barely communicate in English and seemed constantly understaffed. It wasn’t just us — throughout our one-week stay we saw guests arguing with reception daily. Requests went unanswered: we asked five times over two days for an extra duvet, promised each time it would arrive, and it never did. The indoor pool had no water, the gym was in a basement with no AC, no windows, outdated and poorly maintained equipment (looked like it came from the Soviet era), and no water available. Wifi didn’t work, room service was nonexistent unless you spoke Turkish (calls just got hung up on), and restaurant orders were often forgotten — waiting an hour for food only to find they never took the order was common. Housekeeping kept the room generally clean but didn’t change sheets during the entire week — the same stains were there from day one. Cutlery in the restaurant wasn’t clean, there was no ironing board or iron available (they offer to iron for a fee during limited hours), and even the simplest requests like towels required 3+ follow-ups over hours. On the plus side, the breakfast was genuinely nice, and I don’t think the staff are inherently rude — they’re just clearly overworked and unsupported. But the lack of organisation, communication, and service made the stay stressful rather than relaxing. We expected far more from a supposed five-star hotel. Not recommended for English-speaking guests or anyone expecting even basic service standards

We stayed at the Ambrosia hotel for just under a week, we came for the new year party that the hotel was hosting and originally booked to stay for just 1 night as part of their promotion for the event. But we ended up extending by another 3 nights afterwards because we had such a great time. The party was brilliant, when you arrived there was lots of staff to greet you at the entrance with complimentary drinks and horderves. The staff were around for the entire evening across the whole hotel to help with anything we needed. The event itself was fabulous, great dinner service followed by a great band and singer performing, then there was some dancers after the dinner service. We had an amazing new years celebration at Ambrosia. There was a child-minding service during the event too which was great for our youngest child, they played games and read stories in the disco room just across from the main ballroom that the party was held in. The next day we had a lovely buffet for breakfast, the restaurant staff were all very friendly and helpful too. The buffet had a great selection for all preferences too and there was lovely fresh squeezed orange juice that we were told all come from an orchid owned by the hotel, so they grow all of their own organic fruit and vegetables. The rooms were nice and clean and comfortable, housekeeping came everyday to clear the room and changed the bedsheets every 2 days. Lovely housekeeping staff too. The hotel has great amenities as well, there are 2 big swimming pools, one outdoors and one indoors, the indoor pool is heated too which was great at this time of the year. The hotel spa is AMAZING! you can use the sauna/steamrooms/jacuzzis included with your stay and you can book massages, hamans and facials as an extra service. The spa team are very professional too. At the time of reading this review I saw on instagram that the hotel has just received a new 5 star rating, which is well deserved, we had never stayed in a 5 star hotel before however this definitely felt like it was a higher standard than other 4 stars we have stayed with in the past. Highly recommend this hotel for any occasion! 10/10
